text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: Because the vibe is different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...My heart is pounding. Yeah... It's 
just pounding so fast."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is it because my opponent is Creek? Or 
because of all the expectations resting on 
me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...The Arima Kinen I watched with you last 
year. That heat, those voices, that 
excitement—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“—Today, I will take everything. That much 
is certain.”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: With my running, I'll fire everyone up!
